## How we hire

Every engineering candidate goes through the same four steps.

## 1. Intro call

30 minutes with a recruiter. We talk about the role and what you're looking for.

## 2. Take-home

A small project, scoped to about four hours. We pay for your time.

## 3. System design

60 minutes with two engineers. You'll design something close to what the team actually builds.

## 4. Values interview

We want to know how you work with others. Expect to talk through a disagreement you've had.

We aim to get back to you within a week of each step.

## Careers

We're not hiring right now. Check back later or follow us on LinkedIn.

## About Northwind

Founded in 2019, Northwind builds routing software for parcel networks across Europe. We're a team of 40 based in Berlin and Lisbon. Our mission is to make last-mile delivery boring.

## Our team

We're engineers, operators and former couriers.

## Why we dropped the whiteboard interview

For years our loop had a whiteboard algorithms round. We looked at the data: it predicted nothing. So we replaced it with a paid take-home and a pairing session on real code. Here's what changed in our process and what we learned.
